---
title: "Look at different virus prevalence by City"
output:
  pdf_document: default
  html_notebook: default
---


```{r}
# Load necessary libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(data.table)
library(stringr)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(wesanderson)
library(tidyr)
library(rprojroot)
library(eoffice)

# Set paths and filenames
virome_table <- sprintf(
  "%s/data/wastewater_virome_abundance_table1.tsv", 
  find_rstudio_root_file()
)
metadata_table <- sprintf(
  "%s/data/wastewater_sample_metadata_table1.tsv", 
  find_rstudio_root_file()
)

# Merge abundance and metadata tables
virome_dt <- fread(virome_table, sep = "\t", header = TRUE)
meta_dt <- fread(metadata_table, sep = "\t", header = TRUE)
virome_met_dt <- merge(virome_dt, meta_dt, by = "sample_ID")
virome_met_dt$City_Site <- str_c(virome_met_dt$City, ", ", virome_met_dt$Site)

# Calculate virus prevalence by city
city_prev_dt <- virome_met_dt %>%
  group_by(City) %>%
  mutate(total_samples = n_distinct(sample_ID)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(strain, City, total_samples) %>%
  summarize(n = n_distinct(sample_ID)) %>%
  mutate(freq = n / total_samples) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(strain, City, freq) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = City, values_from = freq, values_fill = 0)

# Plot prevalence in Guangzhou and Nanning
city_prev_dt %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Guangzhou, y = Nanning, size = (Guangzhou+Nanning))) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5)

# Extract taxonomic information
tax_table <- virome_dt %>%
  select(c("kingdom", "phylum", "class", 
           "order", "family", "genus", 
           "species", "strain")) %>%
  distinct()

# Merge prevalence and taxonomic information
city_prev_tax_dt <- merge(city_prev_dt, tax_table, by = "strain")

# Create a plot of virus prevalence by family
prevp <- city_prev_tax_dt %>%
  filter(family != "NA") %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  distinct() %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_point(aes(x = Guangzhou, y = Nanning, size = (Nanning+Guangzhou), fill = family), 
             alpha = 0.6, stroke = 1, shape = 21, color = "black") +
  scale_size(range = c(0.1, 5)) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dotted") +
  facet_wrap(~family) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "Guangzhou prevalence", y = "Nanning prevalence") +
  theme(legend.position = "Off",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = -0.2))

# Print the plot
prevp

# Save the plot as a PDF file
ggsave(prevp, file = sprintf("%s/charts/families_by_city.pdf", find_rstudio_root_file()), width = 8, height = 8)

# Save the plot as a PPTX file
pptx_filename <- sprintf("%s/charts/families_by_city.pptx", find_rstudio_root_file())
topptx(prevp, filename = pptx_filename, height = 8, width = 8)
```
